questions.question: When Joshua was old, what did the LORD tell him about the land of Canaan?

answers.text: Very much of the land remains to be possessed
All of the land has now been possessed
The land must wait for a new leader

questions.question: The LORD said the Sidonians and the people of the hill country would be driven out before Israel. Who would drive them out?

answers.text: The tribes east of the Jordan

questions.question: In Joshua's time, the Israelites drove the Geshurites and the Maacathites out of the land east of the Jordan. True or false?
Moses gave the tribe of Levi no land. What was Levi's inheritance instead?

answers.text: The food offerings to the LORD
